faq.a: Aaqilah is associated with the Arabic form عاقلة, whose core sense is wise, intelligent, prudent.

faq.q: What is the origin of Aaqilah?
faq.a: Aaqilah is associated with Arabic. Feminine of عاقل.
Yes — the underlying form عاقلة is Arabic.
Aaqilah can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Aaqilah should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. root ع ق ل occurs in the Qur'an; عاقلة is a normal Arabic feminine form

faq.q: What does Aaqilah mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Aaqilah is rendered عاقلہ and carries the sense عقلمند، دانا، ہوشیار.

faq.q: What does Aaqilah mean in Persian?
faq.a: No verified Persian form was established for Aaqilah.

faq.q: What are the variants of Aaqilah?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Aaqilah, aaqilah, aqilah. Script forms are عاقلة, عاقله, عاقلہ, आक़िला.

faq.q: Is Aaqilah a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
